title: Nyc South Asian Comedy Festival - The Family Friendly Show
description: Experience Laughter Like Never Before at NYC South Asian Comedy Festival
long_description:
Experience Laughter Like Never Before at NYC South Asian Comedy Festival
Laughing Lassi is thrilled to announce the "NYC South Asian Comedy Festival - The Family Friendly Show," scheduled for October 18th, 2026. Experience the joy of laughter in a night filled with humor, fun, and a touch of South Asian spice! This family-friendly event is set to entertain audiences with a hearty dose of Hindi comedy and music. Get ready to laugh out loud as our talented stand-up comedian takes the stage.
Meet Badar Tareen - The Lawyer Turned Comedian
Our event star for the evening is none other than Badar Tareen, a civil rights lawyer by day and a stand-up comedian by night. Badar has a knack for making people laugh with his witty humor and insightful stories. He has showcased his talent at esteemed comedy festivals such as the Desi Comedy Festival, Cleveland Comedy Festival, and Jersey City Comedy Festival. This night promises to be filled with laughter, courtesy of Badar's unique comedic style.
Discover the Magic of Top Secret Comedy Club
The event will take place at the renowned Top Secret Comedy Club, located at 44-46 Avenue A, New York, NY, United States. This venue is not just known for its fantastic shows, but also its safe and accessible location. Nearby attractions add to the appeal of the venue, making it an ideal place to enjoy a fun-filled evening. Parking is available, and for those looking to grab a bite before the show, there are several Indian restaurants in the vicinity that serve delicious food.
Secure Your Seat Now!
Don't miss out on this unforgettable evening of laughter and fun. General tickets are available at just $25.00. Grab your tickets now and ensure an evening filled with comedy, music, and laughter at the NYC South Asian Comedy Festival - The Family Friendly Show.
